## Appearance

Tobias features dark hair and expansive dark eyes that sparkle. His coloration and eye size resemble those of his father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Tobias Corcoran engages in recreational activities such as playing leapfrog. He also possesses the musical skill to play the jew's-harp.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030)_

## History

Tobias Corcoran engaged in local political dealings, at one point bribing [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md); the exchange was accidentally overheard by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), forcing Judson to yield to her demands to keep the bribe quiet. Later, Tobias gathered with [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), and [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where they followed the scent of cooked trout to share a meal and stories with the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children. When [Grace](../character/grace.md) engaged in a loud struggle on the ice after standing barefoot in a snowbank, Tobias assisted [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) in pulling her to safety. Later, [Grace](../character/grace.md) took shared blame alongside Tobias and [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) in a newspaper letter for harvesting potatoes from Evan Garrick's field. Following a scare over a supposed ghost, Tobias punished [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) for running away by ordering him to sit on a tombstone in the cemetery until midnight; Rupert's subsequent exposure to the chilly rain led to a severe case of double pneumonia before he eventually recovered.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +13 more_

## Quotes

> "I suppose I would prefer the corner beside the street. That way, I would be able to listen to the passing teams and the conversations of the people."
>
> — Tobias Corcoran — [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P11](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0011)

> "It is obviously difficult—however, that constitutes the penalty. Right now, I am hungry enough to consume an idol, yet do you hear me grumbling? We should focus on a different topic. Superiority over our appetites is what we must achieve."
>
> — Tobias Corcoran — [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P7](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0007)

> "If you’ll vote for Amesbury, Tibbs . . . well, I’ve a note for that pair of harrows you’ve got in the spring. I suppose you wouldn’t object to having it back, eh?"
>
> — Tobias Corcoran — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061)

> "Rupert holds the greatest responsibility. From what I gather, he was the first to run away. Furthermore, being a boy, he ought to have held his position so as to safeguard you girls, regardless of the peril. Isn’t that right, Rupert?"
>
> — Tobias Corcoran — [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE P6](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0006)

> “Darn it, going to the Methodist prayer meeting is something I won't give up,” Tobias exclaimed. “Ours isn't nearly as much fun as that one is.”
>
> — Tobias Corcoran — [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P74](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Grace](../character/grace.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grace--tobias-corcoran.md)

Tobias and [Grace](../character/grace.md) are siblings who spend much of their time playing with the other children in their family. Together, they visit [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to share meals and stories with the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children, and they assist in discovering and feeding the runaway girl, [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), in a nearby barn. They also participate in local gatherings and join in presenting Mary with farewell gifts upon her adoption.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), +26 more_

### [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ida-ashdown--tobias-corcoran.md)

Tobias is the brother of [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md). The siblings explore their neighborhood together, spending time discussing gravestones and ghosts in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) cemetery before bonding with the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children over meals at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Along with their other siblings, they help care for the runaway [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) by feeding her in a barn and spending time with her until she is eventually adopted by Miss Winifred.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), +27 more_

### [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rupert--tobias-corcoran.md)

Tobias and [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) are brothers who share in many outings with their fellow Ashdown siblings. They frequent the old cemetery and [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) together, sharing meals and socializing with the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) family. They also help care for [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) after finding her hiding in an old barn, ultimately seeing her off with farewell gifts when she finds a permanent home.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), +25 more_
